notes.title: 2024 Optimization Report
notes.content:
The content of this game will be optimized in the near future

 All optimizations have been completed, if there are any bugs please report
 There may be minor corrections in the future, which will not be mentioned in this update
 Every time restart the game, may have to readjust the settings, apologize for any inconvenience caused




Main content has been optimized : 
[olist]
 Optimize main menu
 Optimize setting menu
 Optimize quality setting
 Optimize task list
 Optimize some scene
 Correct the player camera
 Protagonist Yuro model has been changed back to the initial version
 NPC Xiang model update
 NPC Yong model update
 Yuro running speed increases
 Added a shortcut to the ending
 Modify some map/region names
 Delete few objects
 Add a few new objects
 Change task prompts
 Change a few conversations
 Expansion of some indoor scene
 Overlap correction of some material joint
 Reduce the brightness of some light
 Increase the brightness of some light
 Add shadow to some light
 Some light remove shadow
 Added reminder notice board
 Remove one camera angle
 Change the name of some enemy NPC
 Changed the sound effects of being attacked by certain enemy
 Reduce the BGM volume of some scene
 Improve or remove materials that are too bright
 Change shortcut keys for special events
 Modify the dialogue bug caused by NPC disappearing
 Reduce the Tris and Verts of some object
 Remove some scenes to speed up the game progress
 Remove one achievement
 Modify the text/picture of some achievements
 Reduce area damage
 Modify typo
 Delete some conversation events
 Change the destination of some shortcuts
 Fixed the brightness problem of ReflProbe
 Expand the attack range of skills
 NPC Theon model update
 Add animation to stationary object
 Fixed the ground level difference
 Fixed the issue where skill would be lost at some save point
 Cancel some LOD
 Remove some old object and add new one
 Protagonist Yuro model update (one year later)
 NPC Xiang model update (one year later)
 NPC Theon model update (one year later)
 Optimization and modification of scene content one year later
 Removed trees and weeds from some scenes
 Added material to some building components
 Change the BGM of some scenes
 Add one new event and achievement (Forever guarding)
[/olist]


Last update : 20240506

notes.title: [Announcement] Nonschedulrd Update / Discount (2021/09/27 update)
notes.content:
Discount history: 

Discount time: 2021/01/01~2021/01/14
While celebrating the arrival of 2021, the new discount will be released on January 1, 2021, and the discount includes four indie games (three on Steam and one on Google Play) from the beginning of 2019 to the end of 2020. , The discount will last for two weeks. Interested players can also choose the package type below.
Discount time: 2021/06/24~2021/07/08
Celebrating the birth of the new game "MOMIJI FROM PURGATORY" and in conjunction with Steam summer sale event, three independent games sold on Steam in the past simultaneously released discounts.
Discount time: 2021/09/17~2021/10/01
The annual Mid-Autumn Festival holiday is coming soon, and all indie games sold on Steam in the past will be released with a half-price discount (for a period of two weeks)

Repair bug history: 

Hello, everyone, the follow-up update and error repair messages will be concentrated here, because some programs may be changed from time to time, new problems may arise. Once there is a problem, it will take another time to repair. Sorry for the inconvenience!

11/12
Hello, everyone, because there are many bugs after the launch of Steam, although they have been eliminated one after another, but still worried that the player’s save will disappear, so added a new function "shortcut"
The shortcut point is located at: Start a new game> Enter the first picture of the game, next to the cherry blossom tree in garden, there are currently five shortcut points for player to choose (if the original file is still there, can ignore it)

Major bug fix process:
Reduce the protagonist's running speed (to avoid bursting through the wall)
Cancel the jump (to avoid bursting through the wall)
The stuck ladder will be added to the slope (new problems arising after reducing the speed)
Reduced the running speed of most monsters (new problems arising after reducing the speed)

11/13
Other resolved or modified:
Stairs stuck in the old capital
Reduce the running speed of some monsters
Modify the ESC of the scene after one year
Reduce the protagonist's footsteps
Added the purple name of the chaser
Decrease pig attack power by 100>20
Reduce the speed of witch by 1.5>0.8

11/14
After testing with friends, the reason for running speed rush is known: After changing the move code "Update" to "FixedUpdate", it returns to normal

11/15
Fixed the black screen when pass to Chapter 6

11/16
[strike]It is currently known that the trigger aperture event will be stuck[/strike] (Solved)
Reduce the number of rabbits 
Speed up the meal
Give more tips

11/18
Fixed the sound of footsteps when pressing ESC
Update Yuro character module

11/23
Change the BGM of "Greenery world"
Added the ability to skip the ending directly
The protagonist's running speed increased by 4 > 4.5

12/30
Remake Yuro character module again
Solve the problem that the mouse will disappear
Add one achievement

From the starting point to the end point, you can pass all the level without pressure. If you don’t know how to go next, you can directly press ESC to view the strategy steps on the left. If you still have new questions, welcome to respond. For the first contact with bugs Players, I am deeply sorry!
